subject: Co-sponsor: Webinar link mapping + appointment slot pool (Acme Cloud)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@acmecloud.com>, Acme Cloud Events <events@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sponsor: Webinar link mapping + appointment slot pool (Acme Cloud)

Hi Sarah / Acme events team —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the June joint session on LLM inference economics. Two quick coordination asks from our side so we can finalize the invite cadence this week: 

1) Tracking links: can you share the final partner tracking links (UTM + partner param) you want used in (a) initial invite, (b) two reminders, and (c) final confirmation? We need a single authoritative CSV so Marissa can bake them into the sequence.

2) Appointment slots: we'd like to offer 20-minute follow-up sessions after the webinar (hosted by Acme + Redwood engineers). Can you confirm whether you will own the booking flow (your Calendly/AC client) or if Redwood should host a shared pool we can route to? If you host, please share an org-level slot pool (time windows) and the calendar link. If we host, Logan will set up the pool and share the booking page.

Attached: draft_sequence_draft_v3.xlsx (initial invite + 2 reminders + confirmation copy).

If we can get the tracking CSV and slot decision by EOD Wednesday (6/16), Marissa will finalize send windows and we can send the co-branded invite on Thursday.

Appreciate it —

Karthik
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_sequence_draft_v3.xlsx
From: Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Events <events@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Co-sponsor: Webinar link mapping + appointment slot pool (Acme Cloud)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — happy to confirm. Quick answers inline:

1) Tracking links: attached is acme_tracking_links.csv with UTM_source=acme, campaign=redwood-llm-econ, partner_id=ACME-42. Links included for initial invite, reminder 1, reminder 2, and the confirmation/recording page. Our hubspot event id is HS-78910 if you need to map.

2) Slots: Acme will host the booking flow. We can expose a 3-hour daily slot window (10:00–13:00 PT) for two days following the webinar. The booking page is https://cal.acmecloud.com/rdw-partner-slots and we'll provide two engineers per slot.

I've attached a placeholder calendar invite and the tracking CSV. No DocuSign needed — we've already signed the co-host MOU and scanned it into our events folder; I'll attach the MOU PDF for completeness.

We should be good to go once Redwood confirms the invite copy for reminders and the final combined tracking matrix.

—Sarah
Head of Events, Acme Cloud

Attachments: acme_tracking_links.csv, cohost_MOU_draft.pdf, acme_booking_placeholder.ics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sponsor: Webinar link mapping + appointment slot pool (Acme Cloud)

Thanks Sarah — this helps a lot. Quick notes from the ops side: 

- I reviewed the acme_tracking_links.csv and it looks consistent with our naming. I will merge into the master sheet (linked) and generate the final per-email tracking links for dev to instrument.

- Reminder cadence proposal (my recommendation): initial invite (T), reminder 1 (T+3 days), reminder 2 (T-1 day), confirmation (1 hour before) + recording send (T+24 hours). If Acme prefers a different cadence for sponsored sends, tell me which emails you want us to suppress for co-hosted audiences.

- Ownership: since Acme is hosting the booking page, Logan — can you confirm that we will include the Acme booking URL in the confirmation and that we will not offer a Redwood-hosted fallback unless Acme requests it?

I'm attaching the working tracking_links_map.csv that will be the single source of truth once we merge. Also pasted below is the copy I propose for reminder 1 (short, engineering-focused):

---
Subject: Quick reminder: Live demo + LLM serving cost playbook (June 28)
Hi {first_name},
We’re looking forward to showing practical tactics for lowering inference costs while keeping latency tight. Join Acme Cloud + Redwood Inference on June 28 for a 45-minute walkthrough and live Q&A.
Save your seat → {acme_tracking_link_initial}
---

If that copy looks good, I’ll wire it into the send sequence and schedule tests.

Marissa
Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tracking_links_map.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Taylor <sarah.taylor@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sponsor: Webinar link mapping + appointment slot pool (Acme Cloud)

Perfect — thank you both. Finalizing next steps and owners here so nothing slips: 

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: merge Acme CSV into master, publish final tracking map & push to the sends queue (due: Tue 6/18 EOD). Attachment: tracking_links_map.csv.
- Logan: confirm confirmation email includes Acme booking URL and test that the link renders correctly in mobile (due: Mon 6/17).
- Stephanie: coordinate co-branded creative (banner + speaker headshots) and provide PNGs for the invite by Mon 6/17.
- Sarah/Acme: confirm the 10:00–13:00 PT slot window and that the booking page has two engineer slots per timeslot (due: Mon 6/17).

I'll add the final links to the HubSpot event HS-78910 and create a short runbook for the day-of handoff (who picks up the chat/questions). If anything changes to the slot window or tracking parameters, please update the sheet directly and CC the list above.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Karthik
Sr. Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tracking_links_map.csv, runbook_stub.docx
